comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: NOTE: While Ivyro claims that this, along with Naval Xebec, and Armed Trading Xebec can be bought directly from the shipyard, I have found this is not the case. You can only get this from Shipbuilding. Either this was a goof by the Admin, or a past update removed the feature to buy these directly. :/ Moreover, the ports require 60k development before they will appear to be built (I checked Aden and Hormuz, both of them barely have 15k) so these will not be available for quite some time...
